payload.description: BARONS COURT STATION: From Monday 6 July until November, westbound trains will not call at Barons Court. If travelling westbound from the station, please use eastbound District or Piccadilly line trains and change to westbound services at West Kensington (on the District line) or Earls Court (on the Piccadilly line) and change to westbound services. If travelling westbound to the station, please continue to Hammersmith and change for eastbound District or Piccadilly line trains.

KEW GARDENS STATION: Step-free platform interchange between platforms requires a 600m journey via street. Use the North End entrance for the westbound platform. Use the Station Approach entrance for the eastbound platform. To avoid the street level journey, please take a westbound train to Richmond and change to eastbound services there.
HAYES & HARLINGTON STATION: Please travel in the front 8 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)
BURNHAM STATION: Please travel in the front 8 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)
IVER STATION: Please travel in the front 8 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)
MAIDENHEAD STATION: Please travel in the front 7 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)
LANGLEY STATION: Please travel in the front 7 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)
MARYLAND STATION: Please travel in the front 7 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)
FOREST GATE STATION: Please travel in the front 7 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)
MANOR PARK STATION: Please travel in the front 7 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)
SEVEN KINGS STATION: Please travel in the front 7 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)
HANWELL STATION: Please travel in the front 6 coaches if alighting at this station (customers with buggies should travel in the front four coaches)

Step-free routes from Liverpool Street to Kings Cross St Pancras and Euston (via Euston Square): For Kings Cross, take a Metropolitan line eastbound train (platform 1) to Aldgate. Stay on the train. After a few minutes, the train reverses and travels westbound: you can get off at Kings Cross step-free. Eastbound journeys from Kings Cross are step-free direct to Liverpool Street. 

For Euston, take a Metropolitan line eastbound train (platform 1) to Aldgate. Stay on the train. After a few minutes, the train reverses and travels westbound and you can get off at Euston Square step-free. It is then a 10 minute step-free walk via the street to Euston. Euston Square is step-free westbound only, so you cannot do the same journey in reverse to return to Liverpool Street. 

Mini ramps are available at Liverpool Street, Kings Cross and Euston Square. To request a mini ramp speak to a member of staff before you start your journey.

WATERLOO STATION: Although step-free access is available to/from the Bakerloo line southbound platform, the curved platform has large gaps between train and platform, has no manual boarding ramps, and is unsuitable for wheelchair users and those with pushchairs.

Travelling from Surrey Quays to Canonbury and require step-free access? If you are travelling northbound from this station to Canonbury and require a step-free exit, please speak to a member of station staff before you board a train. Our staff will be happy to assist you with your journey.Please note platform 2 remains fully step-free from street to train. Thank you for your patience while we

PIMLICO STATION: From Friday 9 October until late December, no down escalator. Please use the stairs. To avoid the stairs, or if you are travelling with luggage, buggies or small children, please use local bus services 2, 36, or 185 from Vauxhall Bridge Road, stop A for Victoria and stop D for Vauxhall. Route 360 also serves Vauxhall from stop H on Bessborough Street.

CLAPHAM JUNCTION: From Tuesday 24 March 2026 until November 2027, the footbridge at Clapham Junction will be modernised, section by section. The bridge will remain open, but space will be reduced. If you are travelling to or changing trains at Clapham Junction, please allow extra time for your journey.

CLAPHAM JUNCTION: From Tuesday 24 March 2026 until November 2027, the footbridge at Clapham Junction will be modernised, section by section. The bridge will remain open, but space will be reduced. If you are travelling to or changing trains at Clapham Junction, please allow extra time for your journey.

CANADA WATER STATION: Until Spring 2027, no step-free access between street and ticket hall level at this station. This is while we carry out lift replacement work. For step-free access to the Jubilee line, take bus 47 or 188 from stop B1 in the bus station to Bermondsey. For step-free access to the Windrush line, take any bus from stop B2, or bus 1 or 381 from stop C in the bus station to Surrey Quays. Alternatively, it is about an 800m journey to Surrey Quays at street level via Deal Porters Way. You will not be able to use the lift between the street and ticket hall to enter the station. Please plan ahead and allow more time for your journey
BURNT OAK STATION: From Monday 26 October to Sunday 8 November, the station is closed. Please use local London Buses services.

BANK AND MONUMENT STATIONS: From Monday 20 October 2025 until early 2027. Replacement of escalators 4 and 5. These connect the Northern line platforms with the District and Circle line platforms. While this work takes place, the walking route between these platforms will be closed. Please allow a little longer for your journey and follow the signs, which will direct you via an alternative walking route. Depending on your journey, this route may be via street level. To pay the correct fare, just touch out as you exit and touch back in again, as you re-enter.

BANK AND MONUMENT STATIONS: From Monday 20 October 2025 until early 2027. Replacement of escalators 4 and 5. These connect the Northern line platforms with the District and Circle line platforms. While this work takes place, the walking route between these platforms will be closed. Please allow a little longer for your journey and follow the signs, which will direct you via an alternative walking route. Depending on your journey, this route may be via street level. To pay the correct fare, just touch out as you exit and touch back in again, as you re-enter.
Pimlico: reduced escalator service - there is no down escalator in service from the ticket hall due to planned maintenance.

Oval - reduced escalator service - there is no down escalator in service due to a fault. Oval station will operate with an 'up' escalator service only. Please take care when using the spiral staircase, which has 80 steps. Alternatively, use local buses to nearby stations.
Finsbury Park: From Monday 26 October until Sunday 8 November, there will be no step-free access to/from the eastbound Piccadilly and northbound Victoria lines.
payload.additionalInformation: For step-free travel from Finsbury Park, travel westbound on the Piccadilly line or southbound on the Victoria line to Caledonian Road or King's Cross St Pancras. Then travel back on an eastbound Piccadilly line or northbound Victoria line train.For step-free exit at Finsbury Park, travel northbound on the Victoria line to Tottenham Hale,, then return on a southbound train.

payload.description: BUCKHURST HILL STATION: From Monday 10 August until late 2026, the footbridge is closed due to maintenance work. Please use the subway from eastbound platform 2 to access westbound platform 1. Step-free access remains available to both platforms via the ramps.
ARSENAL STATION: Monday 2 and Tuesday 3 November, the station is closed. Please use Finsbury Park or Holloway Road stations instead.

payload.description: Shakhtar Donetsk vs Sporting Lisbon at Stamford Bridge on Tuesday 3 November, 1745 start: Fulham Broadway station will be busier than normal before and after the match. A queuing system and special matchday entrance in Wansdown Place will be in operation once the match has finished.

OVAL STATION: Until mid December, Oval station will operate with an 'up' escalator service only, while planned maintenance takes place on one escalator. Please take care when using the spiral staircase, which has 80 steps. Alternatively, use local buses to nearby stations. Stockwell: Bus 155, from stop R on Kennington Park Road, Vauxhall: Bus 36 185 or 436, from stop D on Harleyford Street
EMBANKMENT STATION: Until spring 2027, there will be a reduced escalator service with alternative routes to the Bakerloo and Northern line platforms, please allow extra time.
